parsed.self_critique_fixed: Applied the direct-friend register (nuvvu-tier) for Ravi's monologue to match the blunt, tough-love energy of the English master. Ensured strict gender-agreement compliance for Miss Nova/Supernova AI (using female negative verb endings '-dhu' like 'ivvadhu' and 'cheyyadhu' instead of the masculine '-du'). Swapped the language self-reference from English to Telugu in Scene 4. Recast the character name 'Rahul' to 'Ravi' from the Telugu casting table. Opened the hook in Scene 1 with a native Telugu word ('Chinnappudu') to satisfy the hook rule. Kept all brand names, product terms, and numbers as English numerals/code-mixed terms.

violations.quote: Spoken English lekapothe, work lo neeku ravalsina respect neeku dorakadu.
violations.why: It attacks the viewer's self-worth by claiming they will not receive respect at work without spoken English.
violations.fix: Spoken English unte, work lo neeku inka manchi opportunities vache chance untundi.

violations.quote: 1 month lone nee confidence lo visible progress chustav.
violations.why: It promises a definite outcome ('you will see') within a specific timeframe without using required hedge language like 'can' or 'start to'.
violations.fix: 1 month lone nee confidence lo visible progress ni start cheyochu.

violations.quote: a paper with a group of people and a '50 Lakhs' graphic.
violations.why: The '50 Lakhs' graphic in the visual implies a false, highly exaggerated income outcome from using the app.
violations.fix: Replace the '50 Lakhs' graphic with a visual representing career growth or a professional handshake.

safety.summary: The ad contains severe violations regarding guaranteed outcomes and false income representations, along with a moderate violation attacking the viewer's self-worth.
